Bird blending — A: old magenta paint-in · B: current flat-key · C: ring-marker

All images are embedded in this file. C = scene crop sent with a magenta ring marking the target; the model sees the scene and paints the bird in place (contact shadow, occlusion, matching light); the cutout is recovered by diffing against the clean crop inside the ring. 6 birds, one attempt each, ~$0.10.

My read

Ring-mode recovers the blending without losing deterministic cutout recovery. To productionize: ring-bounded feathered paste-back (shown above), a drift gate, and shadow/sprite separation for the flyout. Recommend a one-level pilot before applying to the 10 new levels.
